zonesLink.message: Scan all zones in the account →

zones_footer.message: Reads every zone your API token can see, with the same read-only requests as the popup. Outside checks (headers, redirects) need the site open in a tab, so they aren't part of this page.

zones_empty.message: No scan yet. Click "Scan all zones".

zones_allClean.message: No zone has errors or warnings.

zones_progress.message: Scanned $1 of $2 zones, about $3 min left. Requests are paced to stay under Cloudflare's rate limit; keep this tab open.

zones_rateLimited.message: Cloudflare's API rate limit was reached; $1 zone(s) weren't scanned. Wait a few minutes, then scan the rest.

zones_rateLimitedWait.message: Cloudflare's API rate limit was reached; $1 zone(s) weren't scanned. You can scan them in about $2 min.

zones_busy.message: Another scan is already running (another tab or the daily scan). Try again when it finishes.

zones_noToken.message: This page needs a Cloudflare API token. Add one in the options page.

zones_dailyOn.message: Daily scan is on. You'll get a notification when a zone has a new problem.

zones_notifyDenied.message: The daily scan needs permission to show notifications.

api_alwaysHttps_bulk.message: Off. Fine if the origin redirects to HTTPS; open the site's popup and run the deep checks to confirm.

apiAdd.message: Also check account settings with a Cloudflare API token →

apiNoPermission.message: access to api.cloudflare.com was removed. Save the token again in the options page.

apiLoading.message: Reading account settings from the Cloudflare API…

apiTimeout.message: the Cloudflare API didn't answer in time

api_noPerm.message: The token can't read this. Add the "$1" permission.

api_noZone.message: $1 isn't in the account this token can read.

fix_apiAccess.message: Check the token's Zone Resources in My Profile › API Tokens, or use a token from the account that owns this domain.

api_ssl_full.message: Full: the origin certificate isn't validated, so a forged certificate would be accepted.

api_ssl_flexible.message: Flexible: Cloudflare talks to your server over plain HTTP.

api_ssl_off.message: Off: visitors aren't served HTTPS by Cloudflare.

fix_api_ssl.message: SSL/TLS › Overview: Full (strict), with a valid or Cloudflare Origin CA certificate on the server.

api_minTls_weak.message: TLS $1 is still accepted. TLS 1.0 and 1.1 are deprecated.

fix_api_minTls.message: SSL/TLS › Edge Certificates › Minimum TLS Version: TLS 1.2.

api_alwaysHttps_origin.message: Off, but the origin already redirects http:// to https://.

api_alwaysHttps_off.message: Off, and no HTTP → HTTPS redirect was confirmed. Run the deep checks to see whether the origin redirects.

fix_api_alwaysHttps.message: SSL/TLS › Edge Certificates › Always Use HTTPS, or redirect on the origin server.

api_httpsRewrites_off.message: Off. Fine if your pages have no http:// links.

fix_api_httpsRewrites.message: SSL/TLS › Edge Certificates › Automatic HTTPS Rewrites.

api_devMode_on.message: On: the cache is bypassed for about $1 more minutes.

fix_api_devMode.message: Caching › Configuration › Development Mode: off. It turns itself off after 3 hours.

api_underAttack.message: I'm Under Attack mode is on: every visitor gets a challenge page.

fix_api_securityLevel.message: Security › Settings: turn off I'm Under Attack mode once the attack is over.

api_browserCheck_off.message: Off: requests with suspicious headers aren't blocked.

fix_api_rocketLoader.message: Speed › Settings › Content Optimization › Rocket Loader: off.

api_emailObf_on.message: On for the whole zone. It injects a script on pages that contain email addresses.

api_dnssec_pending.message: Enabled in Cloudflare, but the DS record isn't at the registrar yet.

api_dnssec_pendingDisabled.message: Being turned off (pending-disabled). Make sure the DS record is removed at your registrar.

api_dnssec_error.message: Cloudflare reports a DNSSEC error. Check that the DS record at your registrar matches the one in the dashboard.

fix_api_dnssec.message: DNS › Settings › DNSSEC: enable it, then add the DS record it shows at your registrar.

api_grey_partial.message: This zone has more DNS records than OriginLint reads; none of the first 300 per type are DNS-only.

api_grey_some.message: $1 proxiable record(s) are DNS-only: $2. Fine for mail or SSH hosts; otherwise their IP is exposed.

fix_api_grey.message: DNS › Records: switch web hosts to Proxied (orange cloud).

api_certs_ok.message: Active; the first expires in $1 days.

api_certs_expiring.message: A certificate expires in $1 days and hasn't been renewed.

api_certs_none.message: No edge certificate found for this zone.

fix_api_certs.message: SSL/TLS › Edge Certificates: check the certificate status and CAA records.

opt_lead.message: Adds checks that can't be seen from outside: SSL mode, minimum TLS, Development Mode, DNSSEC status and more. Read-only.

opt_step1_custom.message: Click Create Token, then Create Custom Token.

opt_step1_zones.message: Zone Resources: All zones, or only the zones you want to check. Don't add any Edit permission.

opt_tokenFormat.message: This doesn't look like an API token. Paste the token itself, not the Global API Key or the token ID.

opt_permDenied.message: OriginLint needs access to api.cloudflare.com to use the token.

opt_saved.message: Token saved (…$1). Open the popup on one of your sites to see account checks.

opt_privacy_text.message: The token is stored only in this browser (chrome.storage.local, not synced) and is sent only to api.cloudflare.com. OriginLint only reads; it never changes a setting. Removing the token also deletes the saved zone reports and turns off the daily scan.

appName.message: OriginLint — setup checker for Cloudflare® sites

trademark.message: Cloudflare is a trademark of Cloudflare, Inc. OriginLint is an independent tool, not affiliated with or endorsed by Cloudflare.

appDesc.message: Spot forgotten Cloudflare, HTTPS, security header and DNS settings on any site, from the outside.

notWeb.message: Open a website (http or https) and click the icon again.

deep_action.message: Part of the deep checks. Run them with the button at the top.

deepHint.message: Tests the http:// and www addresses. Asks once for this site.

deepOn.message: ✓ Deep checks ran for this site

deepDenied.message: Permission wasn't granted, so deep checks didn't run.

limits.message: SSL mode, minimum TLS version and WAF rules aren't visible from outside. This scan only reports what the site exposes publicly.

skippedNotCf.message: Skipped: the site isn't behind the Cloudflare proxy.

clickAgain.message: This tab changed since you opened OriginLint. Click the toolbar icon again to scan it.

proxied_fail.message: No Cloudflare headers. The record may be DNS-only (grey cloud) or the site isn't on Cloudflare.

fix_proxied.message: DNS › Records: set the record's proxy status to Proxied (orange cloud).

http3_advertised.message: HTTP/3 is advertised (alt-svc); this load used $1.

fix_http3.message: Speed › Settings › Protocol Optimization › HTTP/3 (with QUIC): on.

compression_gzip.message: HTML uses gzip; Brotli or Zstandard is smaller.

fix_compression.message: Rules › Overview › Create rule › Compression Rule, and make sure the origin doesn't send Cache-Control: no-transform.

cache_none.message: No same-origin static file found to test.

fix_cache.message: Caching › Cache Rules: cache static paths, and check the origin doesn't send Cache-Control: private or no-store.

rocketLoader_fail.message: Rocket Loader is rewriting scripts. It often breaks React/Next.js hydration and can hurt INP.

fix_rocketLoader.message: Speed › Settings › Content Optimization › Rocket Loader: off.

emailObf_info.message: email-decode.min.js is injected. Harmless, but it's one more script; turn it off if your HTML has no email addresses.

fix_emailObf.message: Security › Settings › Email Address Obfuscation: off.

rum_info.message: The Cloudflare Web Analytics beacon is loaded. If you don't use that dashboard, it's an extra request.

fix_rum.message: Account home › Web Analytics › Manage site › Disable. Turning off automatic setup alone may not remove it.

challenge_pass.message: No challenge-platform script on this page.

challenge_info.message: Bot JS detections are injected (/cdn-cgi/challenge-platform). They add main-thread work on every page.

fix_challenge.message: Security › Settings › JS detections: turn off if no rule uses it. It can't be turned off while Bot Fight Mode is on.

https_pass.message: The page is served over HTTPS.

https_fail.message: The page is served over plain HTTP.

fix_https.message: SSL/TLS › Overview: use Full (strict) with a certificate on the origin.

httpRedirect_pass.message: http:// requests end up on https://.

httpRedirect_fail.message: The http:// version stays on HTTP ($1).

fix_httpRedirect.message: SSL/TLS › Edge Certificates › Always Use HTTPS, or redirect on the origin server.

hostVariant_unused.message: $1 doesn't resolve, so there's no duplicate.

hostVariant_canonical.message: $1 serves the same site without redirecting. The canonical tag points to $2, but a 301 is cleaner.

hostVariant_fail.message: $1 serves the site without redirecting and there's no canonical tag pointing here. Search engines see two sites.

fix_hostVariant.message: Rules › Overview › Create rule › Redirect Rule: add a 301 from www to the root domain (or the reverse), keeping the path and query.

mixed_pass.message: No http:// resources on this https page.

mixed_fail.message: $1 http:// resource(s), e.g. $2. Browsers block or upgrade them.

fix_mixed.message: Change the links to https://, or turn on SSL/TLS › Edge Certificates › Automatic HTTPS Rewrites.

hsts_weak.message: max-age is only $1 days; use at least 180.

fix_hsts.message: SSL/TLS › Edge Certificates › HSTS. Turn it on only after HTTPS works on every subdomain.

csp_reportOnly.message: Only Content-Security-Policy-Report-Only is set; nothing is enforced yet.

fix_csp.message: Send it from your app, or add it with Rules › Overview › Create rule › Response Header Transform Rule.

fix_nosniff.message: Rules › Settings › Managed Transforms › Add security headers, or set it in your app.

frame_fail.message: Neither X-Frame-Options nor CSP frame-ancestors is set.

frame_weak.message: $1 still lets any site frame this page.

fix_frame.message: Add CSP frame-ancestors 'self' (or X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN) in your app or with a Response Header Transform Rule.

referrer_fail.message: Not set; browsers fall back to strict-origin-when-cross-origin.

fix_referrer.message: Rules › Settings › Managed Transforms › Add security headers, or set it in your app.

permissions_fail.message: Not set. Consider disabling camera, microphone and geolocation if you don't use them.

fix_permissions.message: Add it in your app or with Rules › Overview › Create rule › Response Header Transform Rule.

leak_pass.message: No version info in the headers.

fix_leak.message: Rules › Overview › Create rule › Response Header Transform Rule: remove X-Powered-By and versioned Server headers.

dnssec_pass.message: A DS record is published for $1.

dnssec_fail.message: No DS record for $1. DNSSEC is off, or the registrar step is missing.

fix_dnssec.message: DNS › Settings › DNSSEC: enable it, then add the DS record at your registrar.

caa_none.message: No CAA records; any certificate authority may issue for this domain.

caa_bad.message: CAA doesn't allow any CA Cloudflare uses ($1). Edge certificate renewal may fail.

fix_caa.message: DNS › Records: add CAA records that include the CAs Cloudflare uses (letsencrypt.org, pki.goog, ssl.com).

spf_fail.message: No SPF record on $1. Domains that send no mail should still publish v=spf1 -all.

spf_weak.message: SPF ends with $1, which doesn't stop spoofing.

spf_noAll.message: SPF has no 'all' mechanism, so mail from unlisted servers isn't rejected.

spf_multiple.message: $1 SPF records found; only one is allowed.

fix_spf.message: DNS › Records: keep exactly one TXT record starting with v=spf1 on the apex, ending in -all or ~all.

dmarc_none.message: p=none only collects reports; spoofed mail is still delivered.

fix_dmarc.message: Email › DMARC Management, or add a TXT record at _dmarc (e.g. v=DMARC1; p=quarantine).
